Initial release of Pitch Deck Outline Generator

- Launches an AI-powered tool for generating professional, investor-ready pitch deck outlines using the $1B Pitch Deck Formula.
- Supports two main features: JSON pitch deck outline generation and ready-to-use PowerPoint (PPTX) file creation.
- Provides structured REST API endpoints for outline and presentation generation.
- Ensures output includes key sections: problem, solution, market, business model, traction, team, and funding ask.
- Designed for founders, accelerators, and coaches seeking effective startup presentations.
